limitations: This command does not open a browser or prove interactive rendering, input, FPS, or all conditional network paths.
Map meshopt payloads are authenticated and structurally checked, not decompressed/rendered. Image containers and dimensions are checked, not decoded to pixels.
Nonliteral dynamic imports are reported separately; the legacy kernel manifest is exhaustively checked. Raw binary payloads without metadata are authenticated, not semantically decoded.

26 upstream legacy kernel fingerprints differ from their captured file SHA-256. Their original replay identities and filenames are preserved; every packaged kernel matches captured bytes. These fingerprint comparisons are not claimed to pass.
